content: I've been working on this project https://github.com/guyfischman/FromAxioms that attempts to audit the logical cost of classical math theorems, avoiding Classical.choice and instead building up only from propext, Quot.sound, and principles of omniscience charged explicitly. The artefact it exists to build is at https://guyfischman.github.io/FromAxioms/. It's still pretty unpolished so unless you're really into constructive math it's likely not that interesting.
